title: Unas
description: Last king of Egypt's Dynasty 5. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Unas Famine matches Senusret I Famine"
reign.note: His 33-year reign counted from Dynasty 6's 203 years before the death of Nitocris in 1479 BC; it overlaps Joseph's famine.
